what_changed: 1) Instrument gained a vertical() split - the aggregate filled ROI (-21.3%, CI spans zero) hides two classes whose CIs exclude zero; filled n 278->280, ROI -19.2->-21.3 (two new settled legs, same basis). 2) NEW EXTERNAL: Polymarket taker-fee/rebate repricing effective 2026-11-20 23:59 UTC - politics non-election 0.04->0.01, culture/econ/weather 0.05->0.01, crypto 0.07->0.01, sports 0.05 flat, elections/finance/tech +0.01; maker rebates move from per-market pool share to 3-15% of generated taker fees with a $200k/30d floor = 27.1x our $7,392 flow. 3) src/lib/scoring/price-edge.ts:65 categoryFeeRate() still hardcodes the pre-20-Nov schedule and will overcharge crypto and non-election politics from Friday (Lane A, proposed not applied). 4) LIP re-read to exhaustion: live menu 0/7,499 above gate (max ceiling 0.003526, 3.7x below); the 33% above-gate rate in the 232k feed is entirely retired <=2h 15-minute families (KXCRYPTOLEAD15M, KXTTELITEMATCH, KXTEMPMIAH, gas/copper/platinum/FX 15m); measured net +0.0000890 = 147x below gate. 5) LANE B FIX: scripts/lip-ledger.py reported exhausted=False for a feed that ended on an empty page (a complete read advertising itself as partial); now records end=cursor|ended_empty|capped. Also added a live-menu line so the base rate cannot again be quoted off a mixed all-status population. 6) The lane-wide $25 clip cap was refuted on 2026-11-16 (-$69.21 vs band-scoped); the band-scoped cap (approved 2026-11-12) remains unapplied, and today's 19 longshot $100 legs sit inside its band.
learning: Report the vertical split, never the aggregate: three lottery legs in one class were hiding two classes whose fill-confirmed loss is statistically distinguishable from zero. Second, price the venue's fee schedule before recommending an execution change - a rebate floor 27x above current volume turns 'maker conversion' from a subsidy story into a spread-only story, and the fee itself (2.8-3.6% of dollars at risk) is unbooked in every ROI this book publishes. Third, always separate a feed's all-status base rate from its live menu: 33% of 232k Kalshi programs clear the LIP gate and 0 of 7,499 live ones do.

headline: Adjudication has hit its ceiling: the Sep question vintage carries $5,055 of the $6,076 question profit with a book at dispatch for only 16.5% of legs (73.9% never mapped), while the 100%-adjudicated Oct-Nov question vintage reads -$566 with filled legs at -55%; and the oct+ window's +$551 is entirely $1,418 booked on 313 unfilled legs whose no-fill verdict arrived after the booking

what_changed: 1) Instrument gained three sections: market-clustered CI on every filled band cell, an adjudicability ceiling (L2 epoch + asset-map coverage by vertical x era), and a booking-vs-verdict order split (fillResolvedAt vs close). New script scripts/adjudicability-probe.py measures book-at-dispatch per vintage (scan of data/l2/<assetId>.jsonl for a snapshot in [-60s,+300s]); read-only, no DB write. 2) NEW EXTERNAL: Kalshi shipped keyless GET /incentive_schedules on 2026-11-19 (671 recurring liquidity schedules, reward in centi-cents per window, all_markets promise flag): 0 above the $0.0131 gate, max ceiling $0.002976 (4.4x below), no sub-day windows apart from 15 one-day series and none of the historically-paying families. The LIP question is now answered looking FORWARD, not just for the live menu (0 of 9,503). 3) Polymarket Data API v1 retirement VERIFIED live: /v1/leaderboard returns 410 'Data API v1 has been retired'; /v2/leaderboard 200; our adapter defaults to v2 so no live break, the v1 branch is dead code. 4) CLOB deprecations effective 2026-12-14 (associate_trades, /data/orders asset_id->market, /orders asset_id filter): grepped, we call none. 5) PolyBolt Chainlink-key requirement 2026-11-30 does not touch record-l2.ts (CLOB market socket). 6) The 2026-11-20 23:59 UTC fee repricing is effective tomorrow; price-edge.ts:65 still hardcodes the pre-change rates, reachable from fee.ts only as the proxy fallback. 7) Reddit unreachable this run (429 + 'Welcome to Reddit' interstitial on .rss and old.reddit) - recorded as a gap.
learning: A measurement programme has a ceiling, and it is read off the recorder's own coverage rather than off effort: 73.9% of the vintage that carries the profit sits on markets the L2 recorder never mapped, so no amount of later adjudication can settle it - and the same vertical, where coverage is complete, reports the opposite sign. Second, ordering between a verdict and a booking is a silent restatement channel: every unfilled-leg dollar in the book (all $1,418 of it in the oct+ window, all $2,269 all-time) was booked BEFORE the no-fill verdict existed, so 'fill-aware booking' only protects legs whose verdict already arrived; print fillResolvedAt vs close beside any PnL that a gate reads. Third, report band cells with their own CIs - the aggregate -21.4% spans zero while the sub-0.10 cell is -97.7% [-100,-92.8] on 15 legs, and that cell is two-thirds ordinary clips, so it is a price pathology and not only the $100 tier.
